features.name: Wings of the Sky

effects.note: You have a flight speed equal to your walking speed. You are considered to be wearing light armor for the purposes of any feat or class feature that lets you ignore light armor, such as a Druid's unarmored defense.

features.name: Talons

effects.note: You are considered proficient with light weapons. Your unarmed strike is your talons, dealing 1d4 piercing damage plus your Dexterity modifier. On a critical hit, the damage increases to 1d6.

features.name: Lightfoot
features.text: You are dexterous and have a light step. You gain proficiency in the Stealth and Perception skills.

features.name: Githzerai Magic

effects.note: You know the shield of faith cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot, and you can also cast mage hand. You regain expended uses of mage hand after you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Shield of faith at will, and mage hand once per long rest

features.name: Decisive Speed

effects.note: When you start your turn, you can move up to 10 feet, following the normal rules for your movement, and you can forgo any opportunity attacks that movement would otherwise provoke. You gain the use of this after a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks

features.name: Githzerai Plan

effects.note: You can see, and can communicate with, any creature that can see you and that shares your language. In addition, you gain access to the githyanki and githzerai magic properties listed in the Monstrous Compendium, although you can cast only the githyanki and githzerai magic properties. You do not automatically know any spells.
